summary: Movado Group filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive agreement, effective October 5, 2026, to sell a 95% interest in its EBEL watch brand to a strategic buyer group led by Montres Journe SA, with Chanel and industry veteran Pierre Jacques participating; Jacques will serve as EBEL CEO. Consideration totals approximately $66.5 million, subject to customary closing adjustments, with Movado retaining a 5% minority interest. Closing is expected in Q4 fiscal 2026, contingent on customary conditions including a pre-closing reorganization. The sale sharpens Movado's focus on core accessible-luxury and fashion watch and jewelry brands; watch closing mechanics and any purchase-price adjustment true-up.
